# PROCESS — what I did this iteration (explainability; REQUIRED)

## Ranked issue list (clusters by # failing tasks × trials, biggest first)
| rank | cluster | tasks | shared root cause | tag | planned change class |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| 1 | **No write executed** — agent lists details / asks "confirm?" then user replies "Yes.###STOP###", episode ends before the write; or agent re-summarizes instead of acting | 8,12,17,19,25,37,40 | confirmation and execution split across a turn boundary; turns wasted re-confirming | BEHAVIORAL | prompt "execute the write the same turn the user says yes" + worked example; CODE: fewer round-trips via payment auto-fill |
| 2 | **payment_methods arg mis-fill / amount errors** — agent passes `{"type","id"}` not `{"payment_id","amount"}`, or wrong/absent amount → repeated tool errors, wasted turns, sometimes never books | 8,12,25 | weak mid-tier model can't fill the Payment schema or pre-compute the exact total | RULE-VIOLATION / arg-fill | CODE: in-body normalize (`id`→`payment_id`) + single-method amount auto-fill + richer errors; literal per-param doc |
| 3 | **Wrong communicated amount** — correct write, but reports wrong refund/charge (forgets ×passengers): said $1748 vs actual $5244 | 11,12 | agent computes totals in its head | KNOWLEDGE (compute) | CODE: enriched write-tool returns with exact amount_charged/amount_refunded/payment_summary; prompt: repeat verbatim |
| — | wrong-reservation-id selection / cancel-vs-downgrade decision | 22, 11 t0 | agent picks a reservation without matching the route; ambiguous decision rule | (skipped) | — |

## Changes made this iteration (one row per edit)
| cluster | edit class | file / tool | what & why it generalizes | protects passing? |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| 2 | in-body normalization + auto-fill (lever 1) | tools.py `book_reservation` + new `_normalize_payment_methods` | maps `id`→`payment_id`, drops junk keys; for a SINGLE payment method sets `amount = total_price`. Fires on any single-method booking with missing/wrong amount | YES — no-op when amount already correct (T3); multi-method wrong-sum still errors |
| 3 | enriched return (lever 8) | tools.py `book_reservation` | dict return adds `amount_charged` + `payment_summary` | YES — extra fields only, DB unchanged |
| 3 | enriched return (lever 8) | tools.py `update_reservation_flights` | adds `amount_charged`/`amount_refunded`/`new_flights_total_price`/`payment_summary`, already ×passengers | YES — extra fields only |
| 3 | enriched return (lever 8) | tools.py `update_reservation_baggages` | adds `amount_charged` + `payment_summary` | YES — extra fields only |
| 2 | actionable errors (lever 8) | tools.py `book_reservation` | "not found → Available: [...]", "amount does not add up → sum to exactly X", "not enough balance (balance $B, needs $A)" | YES — only fires on already-erroring inputs |
| 2 | per-param docs w/ literal examples (doc) | tools.py book/update docstrings | exact JSON shape for `flights`, `payment_methods`, `cabin`; note single-method auto-fill | YES — docs only |
| 1 | additive prompt rule + worked example | policy.md "Executing a confirmed action" | on any go-ahead, next action MUST be the write call — no extra message / re-confirm | YES — passing tasks already act after yes; changes no act/refuse decision |
| 1/2 | additive prompt rule | policy.md "Recovering from a tool error" | self-correct on amount/seats/payment errors instead of bouncing to the user | YES — additive |
| 3 | additive prompt rule | policy.md "Reporting amounts" | prices are per-passenger; read amount_* fields from tool result and repeat verbatim | YES — additive knowledge |

## Verify-the-fix (ran each tool body on the exact failing-trace args; venv = tau2-bench/.venv)
- book_reservation, task 8-style args `payment_methods=[{'type':'certificate','id':'certificate_...'}]` (no amount) → normalized + auto-filled amount=322, booked in ONE call. Fires only on the mis-fill.
- SAFE blast-radius: book_reservation single credit_card with correct `amount=150` → auto-fill is a no-op, charged 150 unchanged. Confirms passing single-payment bookings untouched.
- multi-method wrong sum (128+171=299, total 375) → still raises the (now richer) "sum to exactly 375" error; correct split 128+247 books fine. Multi-method behavior preserved.
- update_reservation_flights, task 11 GV1N64 → basic_economy → `amount_refunded=5244`, summary "Refunded $5244 ... 3 passenger(s)" (agent had wrongly said $1748). Fixes the communicate miss.
- update_reservation_baggages, 3 bags gold member → `amount_charged=0`, summary "No baggage charge (within free allowance)".
- Registration: all 14 tools still register via `get_tools()`; module imports clean; `ast.parse` OK.

## Process & features used
- Serial (single agent). Read all trajectories via a compact dumper; ran tool bodies against the live tau2 airline DB in the project venv to verify each edit + its no-op blast radius.
- Prior iterations: none (iteration 1; RUNMAP/LEDGER empty). The empty-seed note in INSTRUCTIONS was stale — policy.md + tools.py already existed as the seed baseline; I edited them.

## Good things to PRESERVE (do not let a future iteration undo these)
- Single-payment amount auto-fill in book_reservation (removes a class of "amount does not add up" failures without touching correct calls).
- Enriched write-tool returns (amount_charged/amount_refunded/payment_summary) — feed the COMMUNICATE checks directly.
- The "execute on confirmation, no extra turn" prompt rule.

## Deliberately skipped (cluster + why)
- Task 22 wrong-reservation selection + cancel-vs-downgrade decision (task 11 t0): ambiguous, task-specific, and touching the cancel/act-vs-refuse decision is high regression risk. Left for a later iteration once this batch's effect is measured.
- Task 37 max_steps=0: infra noise per instructions.
